author: Codex gpt-6.1-sol ultra
decision: Use isolated pre-edge observer plus independent row driver linked to existing policy-enabled SYSTEM archive. No shared source or RTL changes.

facts.claim: Ordinary batch-off MMIO permits 640-byte DEFAULT COPY; the 64-byte restriction applies only controlled-launch hold, which the adapter does not use.
SRC/DST/NB/CONF reach real DMA frontend via cfg AXI; NEXT_ID read reserves/triggers transfer; functional DONE id is cross-checked after actual hardware observer DONE.
640-byte rows are aligned to 8 bytes; rows crossing 4KiB must split AXI requests; normal backend hardware legalizer already performs this splitting without new RTL.
Old V destination PA 0x80001000 lies inside expanded frame source [0x80000000,0x8004b000); must move new row-ring destination PA to 0x80200000.
DID10 and DID11 have separate Sv39 roots, so coincident destination/source IOVA 0x20000000 across their contexts is legal; physical frame, row ring and background rings are disjoint.
Static source supports 75 small-page leaves or one 2MiB source leaf. Fixed 2560-byte ring supports one small-page leaf or one separate 2MiB destination leaf. Both map identical payload addresses.
A IOVA destination 0x20100000 preserves physical destination 0x90100000 and allows both 16-page rings inside one 2MiB mapping rooted at PA0x90000000; 4KiB variant maps L0 indices0..15 and256..271.

Original full-batch ready=previous DONE and 4KiB/count64 validator are microbenchmark-specific, so new mode keeps full_batch/full_era/win_open/win_armed false and uses own observer and contract completion file.
Finite A batch target is configurable and copy completion-driven, gap0; 2048 target with16 pages is ordinary capability, not an M0 limit. Adapter never writes STOP.
CPUoff must drive runtime cpu_enable_i=0 and verify read/write/AMO counts zero; synthetic CPU is not actual CVA6 or cache behavior.

Real data readable completion is observed on hardware DONE and cross-checked against full per-copy bytes/AW-B and memory; quiet checks TL in_flight, both DMA quiet, CPU quiet and empty DDR/AW/B queues.
DS-priority is internal C++ queue scheduling diagnostic, not synthesized implementable baseline. The proposed fixed P baseline keeps ds_priority=false and does not alter memory service.

frozen_interface.t0: after actual three-row initialization, common configuration complete, before any background/foreground steady NEXT_ID trigger
frozen_interface.row_ready: fixed slot release (not startup order or software trigger); source metadata available before t0; frontend availability and cfg cost recorded through actual issue delay
frozen_interface.background_ready: t0 for first copy, prior hardware DONE for later copies
frozen_interface.mode: P policy fixed fullrate; optional S shares same elaborated archive

consumer_semantics.type: fixed prefetch release/deadline observations, no actual Sobel computation
consumer_semantics.at_release: observe exact scheduled release; record whether old owner copy was unfinished; never shift release to hide lateness
consumer_semantics.at_deadline: process pre-edge real hardware DONE then require exact row owner, row DONE and bytes readable; record failure without stopping future copies
consumer_semantics.on_late: all finite copies still complete; report late count; no full-frame FPS/real consumer completion claim
consumer_semantics.initialization_cost: actual three copy MMIO/issue/payload/done/quiet cycles separately recorded; further common preparation to t0 separately recorded

acceptance_interfaces.raw_event_csv: absolute_cycle,phase,phase_cycle,event,channel,job,id,address,value; actual issue/done and AR/AW/B/firstW/accepted R_LAST/W_LAST/DS bursts plus scheduled consumer observations and actual initialization/final quiet readback
acceptance_interfaces.result_json: 480 foreground and2048 background records, per-copy AR/accepted-R/Wbytes/AW/B counts and real issue/done/firstW; init/preparation cost and quiet
acceptance_interfaces.contract_completions_json: 477 records {row,payload_write_start_cycle,done_cycle} relative to shared t0, reusable by workflow_contract.validate_completions
acceptance_interfaces.integrity_exit: 0 only when exact counts, per-copy payload, source immutability, slot guard, functional V DONE ids, A registers and natural completion/quiet pass
acceptance_interfaces.deadline_exit: deadline failure remains independent scientific result, not automatically transport integrity failure

payload_r_last.trigger: accepted payload R with R_LAST; existing beat data/id/resp/LAST CHECK stays
payload_r_last.value: actual accepted beat count (base queue beat+1, equals AR len+1 under retained checks)

payload_w_last.trigger: accepted W_LAST after counting this last beat strobes; existing W data/LAST CHECK stays
payload_w_last.value: sum of popcount(WSTRB) across accepted W beats in that burst

initialization_quiet_and_final_quiet.trigger: after existing check_quiet succeeds; observer write/response queues also CHECKed empty

guard_checks_pass.trigger: after actual full-source immutability, background final-page and row-ring padding CHECKs pass
guard_checks_pass.limitations: event attests driver CHECKs passed; CSV alone does not recompute beat contents or guard contents

trace_event_semantics.offline_validation_scope: burst AR/AW address coverage, accepted R_LAST actual-beat totals, W_LAST strobe totals and B conservation can be independently checked; beat contents remain driver CHECK evidence, with actual PASS log and source provenance

proposal.compile_link_basis: existing obj-policy-system header + __ALL.a + verilated.o; pthread + atomic; no model re-elaboration
proposal.source_guard: SHA256 original sources, old acceptance records and archive/header/binary before root compile; recheck guard after runs
proposal.model_input_metadata: 93 project inputs match generated __verFiles.dat size/mtime/ctime; no project input mismatch
proposal.tool_metadata_caveat: /usr/bin/verilator_bin metadata changed after model generation; current hashes are not retroactive build-time hashes

limits_and_open_checks.issue: Proposal is not yet compiled or simulated; passing interface/source review does not establish numerical timing or byte-conservation success. Root owns actual acceptance.
SYSTEM simulation is diagnostic real-module fabric plus behavioral DDR; cfg bypasses actual CPU fabric, no MIG/clock/width converter or real compute. Cannot infer FPGA/Linux/FPS performance.

Large pages map padding beyond touched payload; resource/padding cost and translation/cache allocation must be counted separately; three2MiB windows represent6MiB translation coverage rather than payload memory requirement.
No standalone workflow-integrity Python checker delivered by this interface seat; parent should independently verify emitted per-copy totals, traces and Fraction contract rather than trust summary.
